description: This file contains Windows-specific initialization code for the Kubernetes kubelet, including setting process priorities and creating Windows job objects.

methods.name: getPriorityValue
methods.description: Returns the Windows process priority class value based on the provided priority class name.

methods.name: createWindowsJobObject
methods.description: Creates a Windows Job Object with specified priority class.

methods.name: initForOS
methods.description: Initializes Windows-specific settings for kubelet, including setting process priority and creating a job object.
